headline: Sangrur Leads Punjab Fire Counts as Patiala Air Quality Forecasted
briefing: On 2024-11-01, Sangrur recorded 97 fire detections with a total fire radiative power of 770.3 MW, ranking 1 among Punjab's districts as Punjab recorded 603 total detections. This count reflects a 149.6% change vs its 7-day mean of 38.9. Satellite detections represent a lower bound on actual fire activity due to cloud cover and overpass timing [K087]. At nearby Patiala, today's PM2.5 level was 42.9 ug/m3. Winds blew from the WNW at 9.9 km/h. As background context, the upwind fire pressure score was 1587.4, with Sangrur contributing a 20.5% share. For 2024-11-02, Patiala's next-day PM2.5 forecast projects a p50 median of 47.8 ug/m3. The forecast uncertainty band spans an 80% interval from a p10 of 36.5 ug/m3 to a p90 of 64.5 ug/m3. Model reliability testing indicates a mean absolute error of 10.5 ug/m3.

# Sangrur: fire detections, season 2023

In the 2023 season (Sep 15 to Nov 30), satellite fire detection (VIIRS S-NPP) recorded 5,002 fire detections in Sangrur district, with a total fire radiative power of 33,371 MW. Among the 22 districts it ranked number 1 by detections.

The busiest day was 2023-11-05, with 554 detections.

Compared with the previous season: -5% compared with 2022 (5,273 detections).
